channel.title: UEFA Champions League Football
channel.desc: The drama of the final round of fixtures in the league phase includes holders Paris Saint-Germain against Newcastle, Napoli versus Chelsea, and Liverpool taking on Qarabag. 2023 winners Manchester City host Galatasaray, Tottenham travel to Frankfurt and leaders Arsenal meet Kazakh champions Kairat. Elsewhere, 15-time winners Real Madrid face Jose Mourinho's Benfica, Borussia Dortmund play 2025 runners-up Inter Milan, and Barcelona entertain Copenhagen.
